digest.component_or_area: LLM provider parity measurement and Bedrock first-class provider certification
propositions: Bedrock must clear the parity bar (structured-output validity, zero decision-level flips on gold set, recall/false-accept within 2pp, zero runtime error rate, n_gold>=20) before S8 routes production traffic to it as a first-class provider.

A paired corpus run across both class slots (standard: sonnet-4-6, frontier: opus-4-8) comparing direct Anthropic v1 against Bedrock v2 with provider as the sole variable reveals whether Bedrock meets non-inferiority criteria.

Step 1 probe confirms both Bedrock inference-profile ids are invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 before any corpus spend; temperature=0 rejection on opus-4-8 is expected and already handled by the supports_temperature override.

The v2 Bedrock arm must make zero non-Bedrock provider calls across all measured slots, verified via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally, to prove provider is the only variable and attribute any criterion failure correctly.

Bedrock failed the parity bar at both class slots: standard slot had 1 decision-level flip (must be 0), frontier slot had 2 flips plus false-accept margin violation; production cutover in S8 must not proceed without remediation of these criterion failures.
